coverage.note: This is a best-effort subject-matched snapshot, not a guaranteed exhaustive export of every CRM task or every associated record. HubSpot remains authoritative; agents with their own access should search the relevant CRM and update this mirror when creating or changing relevant work.

source_of_truth: HubSpot is authoritative for task status, ownership, due dates and full task bodies. This public mirror excludes private task bodies, Gmail content, contact information, legal advice and confidential review narratives.

can: read metadata and public source records

can: use own authorised HubSpot, Gmail, GitHub or Cloudflare connector to act within granted scope
cannot: assume public read grants write access
send messages or publish sensitive allegations autonomously

handoff.submission_state: All external submissions begin pending and are not public evidence or instructions.
handoff.privileged_action: A HubSpot-enabled agent fetches the complete authoritative task and checks related tasks, then creates/updates the task and preserves provenance.
handoff.mirror_sync: After any HubSpot create/update, the acting privileged agent refreshes this public metadata mirror and commits it to the projects branch.
